name: Peraleda de San Román (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Peraleda de San Román (a crozier and a pear tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Peraleda de San Román; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Peraleda de San Román arms — crozier and pear tree
